changelog:
Initial release of firecrawl-build-onboarding:  
- Provides step-by-step guidance for obtaining Firecrawl credentials and setting up the SDK in a project.
- Includes its own browser-based authentication flow, independent from other onboarding skills.
- Covers configuration for `.env` (`FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`, `FIRECRAWL_API_URL`) and SDK installation references.
- Offers integration paths for both new and existing projects with relevant documentation links.
- Bundles recommended CLI and build skills for streamlined onboarding.
summary: Get Firecrawl credentials and SDK setup into a project. Use when an application needs `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`, when an agent should add Firecrawl to `.env`, when...
